candidates.title: Gleipnir
candidates.reason: Across the complete 13-episode 2020 anime, timid Shuichi can transform into a living monster costume that Clair enters and controls, and their dangerous partnership investigates alien coins that grant people disparate monstrous powers. Searching for Clair's missing sister and Shuichi's concealed memories leads to rival coin collectors, uneasy alliances, manipulation, lethal ambushes and progressively disclosed motives. The mountain arc particularly emphasizes tactical group maneuvering and betrayals; shapeshifting, shared-body fighting, varied abilities, violent consequences and body-horror imagery support dark supernatural action. The alien origin adds a genuine science-fiction premise, but the coins' power rules remain only partly explained. Shuichi gains resolve and discovers combination techniques rather than undergoing sustained structured training or steady power growth. Whole-season reviews praise some fights, striking transformations and suspense, while disagreeing about animation consistency and criticizing heavy sexualized fanservice, uneven characterization, increasingly convoluted revelations and an inconclusive anime ending. This evidence covers the 2020 television adaptation only, not subsequent manga chapters.
